front_wheel.name: Front Tyre and Wheel
front_wheel.torque: Do not loosen axle or brake fasteners at home.
front_wheel.notes: Replace a tyre with sidewall cuts, cords showing, or persistent pressure loss; do not DIY-repair a sidewall.

rear_wheel.name: Rear Tyre and Wheel
rear_wheel.torque: Do not loosen axle or brake fasteners at home.
rear_wheel.notes: Use the pressure printed in this scooter's owner manual or tyre placard, not a generic internet value.

tyre_valve.name: Tyre Valve Cap and Core
tyre_valve.notes: Bubbles around the valve with soapy water indicate a leak; use a tyre shop for core replacement.

battery.name: 12 V Scooter Battery
battery.torque: Terminal screws snug only; connect positive first, negative last.
battery.notes: Do not short terminals, smoke nearby, or charge a swollen, cracked, or leaking battery.

fuse_box.name: Main Fuse Box
fuse_box.torque: Use only the exact amperage printed on the removed fuse.
fuse_box.service_interval: Inspect only after an electrical fault.
fuse_box.notes: A replacement fuse that blows again is a wiring fault: stop and use a mechanic.

air_filter.name: Air Filter Element
air_filter.notes: Never run the engine with the filter or cover removed.

oil_dipstick.name: Engine-Oil Dipstick
oil_dipstick.service_interval: Check weekly with the engine cool.
oil_dipstick.notes: Use only the grade and quantity in the owner manual. Overfilling can damage the engine.

headlamp.name: Headlamp Assembly
headlamp.notes: If a fuse blows again or wiring is warm, stop and use a mechanic.

handlebar.name: Handlebar Controls
handlebar.torque: Do not dismantle throttle or brake controls at home.
handlebar.notes: A sticky throttle, brake issue, or steering play requires professional service.
